evidence.claim: Renishaw FY2025 (year-end June 30, 2025): record revenue of £713.0M (+3.1% YoY), adjusted PBT £127.2M (+3.8%); gross margin ex-engineering costs 61.7% (improved); laser encoders were best-performing product line FY2025; management cited 'good revenue growth from position encoders' within Manufacturing Technologies; robotics and industrial automation explicitly cited as demand driver
evidence.source: Renishaw FY2025 full-year results presentation; DirectorsTalkInterviews FY2025 coverage

evidence.claim: ASTRiA inductive rotary absolute encoder launched FY2025: total system accuracy ±40 arc seconds, 23-bit resolution at Ø100mm; multi-track inductive scanning (no line-of-sight), immune to dirt/oil/contamination, survives 30g shock, no calibration required, self-centring rotor, up to 9,000 rpm; target applications: gimbals, robots, servo motors, UAVs, medical devices, defense; direct competitor to Heidenhain ECI/EQI inductive line; squarely aimed at humanoid robot joint segment
evidence.source: Renishaw ASTRiA product page; Renishaw FY2025 results commentary

evidence.claim: PAL Robotics REEM-C humanoid documented use of RLS/Renishaw AksIM-2 (off-axis absolute, hollow bore) and Orbis (compact rotary) magnetic encoders in knee, wrist, and elbow joints; 14-20 crossed roller bearings per humanoid → 30-50 encoders per robot at $90-200/unit = ~$6,000 encoder cost per robot; absolute encoders mandatory (safety-critical absolute position on power-up without dangerous homing move)
evidence.source: Renishaw/RLS case study — PAL Robotics REEM-C; RLS Humanoid Robots applications page; TheRobotReport PAL Robotics integration article

evidence.claim: China's CT-Unite launched first GaN-based encoder chip (CT-21X) for humanoid robot joints in May 2026: ±0.1° angular error, <2μs latency, 1-5 MHz bandwidth, 300,000 rpm, 40-50% smaller than conventional solutions; mass production expected Q3 2026; represents direct Chinese substitute for Broadcom AEAT encoder ICs at the chip level; reduces Chinese humanoid OEM dependency on Western encoder IC supply chains
evidence.source: New Electronics CT-Unite article; TrendForce May 2026

evidence.claim: Encoder market not currently supply-constrained: at 2025 production volumes (thousands of humanoid units globally), encoder demand is far below levels stressing supply chains; multiple qualified Western suppliers (Renishaw/RLS, Heidenhain, Broadcom AEAT-based assemblies, Chinese alternatives); the real bottleneck is system-level calibration and qualification throughput, not raw component supply; binding supply constraint estimated only at 100,000-1,000,000 units/year scale
evidence.source: Serenity supply chain analysis; DataInsightsMarket Humanoid Robot Encoder Market report

what_could_weaken_view: Encoder layer is not a hard bottleneck: multiple qualified suppliers (Renishaw/RLS, Heidenhain, Broadcom AEAT-based assemblies) mean no single company can extract monopoly pricing; the scarcity is in calibration/qualification throughput, not Renishaw's product specifically

Chinese domestic encoder chip development removes Chinese humanoid OEM dependency: CT-Unite's GaN encoder chip (mass production Q3 2026) means the fastest-growing humanoid market (90% of 2025 global units) sources domestically; Renishaw's growth is concentrated in Western humanoid OEMs (Tesla, Figure, Agility, Boston Dynamics) which are a smaller fraction of unit volume

Renishaw family concentration governance risk: founders retained significant voting control; succession/strategic decisions may not prioritize external shareholder returns; UK mid-cap status limits index inclusion and institutional coverage relative to global peers

Cyclicality from semiconductor capital equipment: laser encoders (best-performing FY2025 product) are exposed to semiconductor wafer-handling equipment capex cycles; a semiconductor capex downturn compresses the highest-margin encoder segment

ASTRiA competitive response from Heidenhain: Heidenhain has the ECI/EQI inductive line presented at AUTOMATICA 2025 with same contamination-immunity positioning; Renishaw's ASTRiA is not differentiated against the strongest competitor in the inductive robot encoder segment
